No evidence of obfuscated code, unauthorized data exfiltration, or remote code execution is present. The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and does not introduce any supply-chain risks. While the source uses a tagged release rather than a pinned commit (a minor hygiene concern), this is common in AUR packages and does not constitute a security flaw on its own.
